name: Active buzzer 5 V (12 mm)
description: Beeps at a fixed tone when powered. Switch it with a transistor from a GPIO.
notes: Active = built-in oscillator: apply DC and it beeps. Passive buzzers look the same but need a PWM tone.
Current about 25-35 mA at 5 V: above the recommended current of most GPIO, so use an NPN transistor or MOSFET.

pins.label: + (long leg)
pins.note: About 30 mA at 5 V: drive through a transistor rather than directly from a GPIO.
